highlights: Customer Self-Service Portal & Collector End-of-Day Reconciliation
changes: Customer Self-Service Portal: Separate customer authentication via WhatsApp/SMS OTP and password, customer-scoped JWT tokens, live plan tracking, FUP quota meter, daily MB breakdown, invoices & payments history, statement ledger, and support tickets with reply conversations

Collector End-of-Day Cash Summary (Bug #115): End-of-day daily reconciliation endpoints (/collectors/me/day-summary and /collectors/:id/day-summary), interactive shift date navigator, multi-currency collections, discount tracking, and unhanded cash calculations
Thermal 80mm Handover Slip: Printable 80mm thermal receipt slip for cash envelope verification with dual signature blocks
Receipt Collection Date Filters: Added paid_from and paid_to filters and paid_at timestamps to receipts query for accurate collection reporting
Staff Customer Portal Controls: In-drawer portal access toggle, password setting, link copying, and direct WhatsApp invite
